# Fine Glaze

> Fine Glaze is a specialist facade contractor based in Pune, India, operating in Pune and Mumbai. It designs, fabricates, installs and maintains curtain walls, structural glazing, aluminium windows and doors, ACP cladding, aluminium louvers, glass railings, skylights, glass partitions and facade AMC for developers and building owners.

## Key facts (from the Fine Glaze Company Profile 2026–27)

- Operating cities: Pune and Mumbai (incl. PCMC, Navi Mumbai, Thane, Panvel). Projects elsewhere in India are considered case by case.
- Facade delivered: approx. 20,566 sqm across Pune and Mumbai; 16 project records documented.
- Team: 40+ core engineering, supervision and site team. Founder & Proprietor Deepak Gupta — B.E. Civil, 11+ years in the facade industry including the Al Ghurair Group.
- Fabrication unit: approx. 2,500 sq ft at Pisoli, Pune.
- Award: Best Vendor Performance 2024 from Embassy REIT, for the Embassy 247 (Vikhroli, Mumbai) project.
- Clients: Embassy REIT, L&T Construction, Jindal Stainless Limited, Nirmaann Encon Developer, Hatchway Windoor Pvt. Ltd., Rockfort Estate Developers.
- Material partners: Saint-Gobain glass, Alubond ACP, DOWSIL silicones, extrusions from major Indian mills — or the project's approved vendor list.
- Quality: in-house shop drawings and wind-load checks, stage inspections, site water penetration test; third-party ASTM testing arranged on request.
- Credentials: proprietorship firm, GSTIN 27BFJPG1853A1ZU, registered word mark. ISO 9001/14001/45001 certification is in process (not yet granted).
- Contact: +91 83692 33566 · 020-6829-9428 · info@fineglaze.com · A3 LW-13, Pragati Serene Building, Mohammed Wadi, Pune 411060. Hours Mon–Sat 09:00–18:00.
